title: Gravitee OTel · API Program Overview
description: Every API managed by Gravitee APIM, from its OpenTelemetry signals: traffic, availability, latency attribution, consumers and policy outcomes. No Elasticsearch.

panels.title: API calls
panels.description: API calls handled by the Gateway in the selected range, from its OpenTelemetry spans.

panels.title: Availability (non-5xx)
panels.description: Share of calls that did NOT end in a 5xx. 4xx are the consumer's fault and don't count.

panels.title: P95 response time
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time seen by the consumer, from the span histograms.

panels.title: Gateway overhead (avg)
panels.description: Average time spent inside Gravitee (policies, security, routing): server span minus backend span. An average, because percentiles can't be subtracted.

targets.expr: clamp_min(sum (rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_sum{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range])) / sum (rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_count{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range])) - sum (rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_sum{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range])) / sum (rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_count{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range])), 0)

panels.title: Active APIs
panels.description: APIs that received at least one call in the range.

panels.title: Active applications
panels.description: Subscribed applications that called an API (keyless traffic excluded).

panels.title: Rate-limited calls (429)
panels.description: Calls rejected by rate-limit / quota policies: usually a consumer that needs a bigger plan.

panels.title: Rejected credentials (401/403)
panels.description: Calls refused by plan security (missing or invalid API key, JWT, OAuth2 token) or access control.

panels.title: Logged calls
panels.description: Calls with OTel logs (payloads) in Loki, per each API's logging condition.

panels.title: Calls by API
panels.description: Click a series name to isolate it.

targets.expr: (sum by (gravitee_api_name) (rate(gravitee_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", gravitee_api_name=~"$api", http_status_code=~"5.."}[1m])) or sum by (gravitee_api_name) (rate(gravitee_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[1m])) * 0) / sum by (gravitee_api_name) (rate(gravitee_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[1m]))

panels.title: Response time percentiles (consumer view)
panels.description: End-to-end time observed by the consumer.

panels.title: P95: total vs backend, and gateway overhead
panels.description: If 'Total' moves with 'Backend', the slowness is upstream. If it moves with the overhead, look at policies.

targets.expr: clamp_min(sum (rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_sum{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range])) / sum (rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_count{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range])) - sum (rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_sum{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range])) / sum (rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_count{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range])), 0)

panels.title: Latency by API (ms)
panels.description: Click an API name to open its drill-down.

targets.expr: clamp_min(sum by (gravitee_api_name) (rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_sum{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range])) / sum by (gravitee_api_name) (rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_count{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range])) - sum by (gravitee_api_name) (rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_sum{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range])) / sum by (gravitee_api_name) (rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_count{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range])), 0)

panels.title: Top APIs by P95 response time
Top applications by calls
panels.description: '(keyless / rejected)': keyless plans, and calls rejected before an application was identified.

panels.title: Top plans by calls
panels.description: Plans are identified by their flow (spans carry no plan id), so a plan without a flow isn't counted. The name is the flow's name.

panels.title: Gateway rejections by reason (failure key)
panels.description: Calls a policy refused or failed, by Gravitee failure key (RATE_LIMIT_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, QUOTA_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS…). Calls refused by plan security (no or invalid key) have no failure key: see the 401/403 counts.

panels.title: Rejections by policy
panels.description: Which policy stopped the call.

panels.title: Rate-limited (429) by application
panels.description: Who is hitting their plan limits: candidates for a plan upgrade.

panels.title: Backend failures by API
panels.description: Status codes returned by the backends (the Gateway's client spans).

panels.title: Latest failed calls (5xx)
panels.description: Click a trace to open its spans (phases, plan flow, each policy, the backend call) and its logged payloads.

panels.title: Latest slow calls (> 1 s)
panels.description: Click a trace to open its spans (phases, plan flow, each policy, the backend call) and its logged payloads.
